_about: The pet hotel prototypes (proto-pets, 2 Nov 2026; look after the animals, going home: build/reports/designs/adoption-centre.md and its critique): the words and lines the two games need that the family has not recorded yet. Every one is an English placeholder (kutchi: null), to record; build/lang/import_modes.mjs turns each word into a to-record entry (pos from `pos` where given, else a noun) and each line into an engine meaning, so the games ask the language engine for them like any other line and it answers with the grey-italic English. Nothing here is Kutchi: dog (kutro), bird (chakli), wash (dho), corn (makai), big and small (wadho, nindho) and bye (achija) are the engine's own. Re-run node build/lang/import_all.mjs after a change.
